name: Emergence of Classes: population and the way out of fractiousness (Fig. 5)
description: Axtell, Epstein and Young's Fig. 5: the same transition time against the number of agents at m = 10. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-25): at ε = 0.05, 1060, 3460 and 36 700 periods at N = 10, 20, 30, and every run capped at 100 000 from N = 40; at ε = 0.1, 168, 161, 362, 694 and 16 600 at N = 10, 20, 30, 40, 60. Steep growth with N, as the paper says.
